10788.problem: Write `deinterleave_bits(z)` — extract x and y from Morton code. Test round-trip.
10788.answer:
func deinterleave_bits(z) = {
  local x = 0
  local y = 0
  local bit = 0
  local zz = z
  while (zz > 0) {
    x = x + (zz % 2) * (2 ^ bit)
    zz = floor(zz / 2)
    y = y + (zz % 2) * (2 ^ bit)
    zz = floor(zz / 2)
    bit = bit + 1
  }
  {"x": x, "y": y}
}

func interleave_bits(x, y) = {
  local z = 0
  local xx = x
  local yy = y
  local bit = 0
  while (xx > 0 || yy > 0) {
    z = z + (xx % 2) * (2 ^ (2*bit))
    z = z + (yy % 2) * (2 ^ (2*bit+1))
    xx = floor(xx / 2)
    yy = floor(yy / 2)
    bit = bit + 1
  }
  z
}

local morton = interleave_bits(5, 3)
println("Morton: " _ morton)
println(deinterleave_bits(morton))

10792.problem: Write `ieee754_encode_simple(mantissa, exponent)` — simplified 8-bit float: sign+3-exp+4-mant. Test.
10792.answer:
func ieee754_encode_simple(mantissa, exponent) = {
  local sign = if (mantissa < 0) 1 else 0
  local bias = 3
  local exp_biased = exponent + bias
  local mant_abs = abs(mantissa)
  local mant_int = round((mant_abs - floor(mant_abs)) * 16) % 16
  local byte_val = sign * 128 + exp_biased * 16 + mant_int
  {"sign": sign, "exp": exp_biased, "mantissa_bits": mant_int, "byte": byte_val}
}

println(ieee754_encode_simple(1.5, 0))
println(ieee754_encode_simple(-1.25, 1))

10935.problem: Write `selectInstructions(ir)` — map IR operations to machine instructions. Return list. Test.
10935.answer:
func selectInstructions(ir) = {
  local machine = []
  for (op in ir) {
    local mop = if (op === "add") "ADD R0,R1"
      else if (op === "sub") "SUB R0,R1"
      else if (op === "mul") "MUL R0,R1"
      else if (op === "load") "LDR R0,[SP]"
      else if (op === "store") "STR R0,[SP]"
      else "NOP"
    machine.add(mop)
  }
  machine
}

println(selectInstructions(["load","add","mul","store"]))

11056.problem: Write `liveIntervalColor(var, start, end)` — hash var name to hue, brightness by interval length. Test.
11056.answer:
func liveIntervalColor(var, start, end) = {
  local hash = 0
  for (i: 1 .. var.textLen()) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + var.segment(i,1).textLen()) % 360
  }
  local length = end - start
  local brightness = if (length > 20) 200 else round(100 + length * 5)
  local hue = hash
  local r = round(abs(cos(radians(hue))) * brightness)
  local g = round(abs(cos(radians(hue - 120))) * brightness)
  local b = round(abs(cos(radians(hue - 240))) * brightness)
  makeColor([r, g, b])
}

println(liveIntervalColor("x", 0, 10))
println(liveIntervalColor("temp_var", 5, 30))
